read.thesis: RTX Q3 2024 call: record $221B backlog (book-to-bill 1.8) and raised 2024 sales/EPS guidance, but Collins commercial OE cut to flat on Boeing strike and GTF powder-metal payments slid to about $1B.

capex.quote: This, combined with slightly lower CapEx is expected to offset the working capital impacts associated with the lower commercial OE volume at Collins.

triggers.label: Adj. sales guide raised to $79.25-79.75B
triggers.quote: we're increasing our full year adjusted sales outlook to between $79.25 billion and $79.75 billion, up from our prior range
triggers.highlight: increasing our full year adjusted sales outlook

triggers.label: Collins OE cut to flat from mid-single digit
triggers.quote: commercial OE is now expected to be flat for the year, and that's down from our prior expectation of mid-single digit growth.
triggers.highlight: commercial OE is now expected to be flat

triggers.label: Backlog $221B, book-to-bill 1.8
triggers.quote: ended the quarter at a record $221 billion with a book-to-bill of 1.8
triggers.highlight: record $221 billion with a book-to-bill of 1.8

triggers.label: Inventory build cut FCF in quarter
triggers.quote: free cash flow was again strong at $2 billion as continued strength in collections helped offset some higher inventory

guidance.quote: we're increasing our full year adjusted sales outlook to between $79.25 billion and $79.75 billion
putting the new range at $5.50 to $5.58, up from $5.35 to $5.45
we continue to expect approximately 8% to 9% organic sales growth for the full year
we remain on track to achieve our outlook of approximately $4.7 billion
we are updating the outlook for operating profit to grow between $575 million and $650 million versus 2023
up from our prior range of between $400 million and $475 million
we now expect Raytheon's operating profit to grow between $200 million and $250 million versus 2023
we now expect powder metal outflows to be about $1 billion down $250 million from our prior expectation

red_flags.label: GTF powder metal payments continue into 2025-2026
red_flags.quote: payments will continue into 2025 and potentially 2026, subject to remaining aircraft on ground

red_flags.label: Collins 787 seating certification drag
red_flags.quote: we did have about $35 million of contract headwind in the quarter

evasions.quote: I won't get into specifics around when we expect the ultimate payments to make place

evasions.topic: Raytheon productivity return to pre-pandemic levels
evasions.quote: Whether we get back to the same levels of the kind of productivity, I think, depends entirely on the mix and the environment
